# markdown test suite

## Source

The CommonMark spec's examples (github.com/commonmark/commonmark-spec, CC-BY-SA 4.0, Copyright (C) 2014-16 John MacFarlane), as the spec site publishes them in `spec.json`: every example's `markdown`, one file for each, `valid/<section>/example-<number>.md`. CommonMark reads every text as a document, so no example is invalid; `invalid/` holds the one file this language adds, bytes that are not UTF-8, which `NOTICE` names.

## Version

CommonMark 0.31.2, `https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/spec.json`, from the tag `0.31.2` (commit `9103e341a973013013bb1a80e13567007c5cef6f`): 652 examples in 26 sections.
